newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan sells two Mar gas oil cargoes around $25.60.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sells two Mar gas oil cargoes around $25.60.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) sold by tender two gas oil cargoes at around $25.60 a barrel for March 1-12 lifting, free-on-board (fob) Kaohsiung, a CPC source said on Thursday.
The cargoes of 0.3-percent sulphur gas oil are 225,000-250,000 each.
The tender, which closed on February 18, attracted about five bids.
In its last tender, CPC also sold two 225,000-250,000-barrel cargoes of gas oil at around $29.50 a barrel for January 26-February 15 lifting, fob Kaohsiung.
